notes.editorial_method: All 22 source paragraphs in Sections A and B were reread and manually rewritten. Telugu supplies the narration and connectors, while English is retained for technical, scientific, legal and programme terms. No paragraph is an English paragraph followed by a Telugu translation.
source_concerns: The canonical-html locator is local:teaching_en.html|teaching_te.html, but those files are not present at a resolvable repository path. The manifest text was therefore treated as the selected canonical source for this draft.

All 2026 totals and events—sixth AITE commencement, cheetah totals, Great Indian Bustard captive totals and Project H.A.N.U.M.A.N.—are date-sensitive current-affairs claims and require a dated official citation before publication.
The tiger figures 3,682 and 3,652 are not interchangeable. Each must retain its own official source label and the NTCA uncertainty range where relevant.
The 2021–25 elephant estimate uses a new DNA-based method and should not be presented as a simple percentage decline from either 2017 headline total.
The 6,327 dolphin estimate covers the surveyed river systems, not all freshwater, estuarine and marine dolphins within Project Dolphin.
The National Vulture Action Plan 2020–25 has completed its stated period; it must not be called the current plan unless a successor or extension is officially verified.
mcq_coverage_gaps: No dedicated question tests the opening three-way distinction: IUCN extinction risk versus CITES international trade control versus WPA domestic legal protection.
No dedicated question tests Census versus Estimate or the joint WII–NTCA role described in the Section B opening paragraph.
Section A does not directly test EW's full definition (captivity/cultivation/naturalised population outside native range) or the strict evidentiary meaning of EX.
Criterion A1 thresholds (90/70/50), the ten-years-or-three-generations rule and Criterion D without demonstrated decline lack direct coverage.
Project Elephant's full objective set—wild elephants, habitats/corridors, conflict management and captive-elephant welfare—is compressed into one broad fact question.
Section B lacks direct questions on Project Lion announcement/approval dates, the 674-to-891 comparison and the fact that many lions occur outside protected areas.
Snow-leopard threats, Project Crocodile's Government–UNDP–FAO partnership and its reported 7,000-plus releases are not independently tested.
The 2006 veterinary diclofenac ban and the ecological distinction between habitat-loss and toxic-drug causation need direct factual or assertion–reason coverage.

title.en: Reading conservation status and flagship programmes
title.te: Conservation status, flagship programmesను ఎలా అర్థం చేసుకోవాలి?

paragraphs.en: Wildlife questions often place IUCN, CITES and India's Wild Life (Protection) Act side by side, although they answer different questions. The IUCN Red List estimates a species' global extinction risk. CITES regulates international trade in listed species, while the WPA supplies legal protection within India. A species can therefore carry an IUCN category, a CITES Appendix listing and a WPA Schedule listing at the same time; one label cannot substitute for another.
paragraphs.te: Wildlife conservationలో IUCN Red List, CITES, Wild Life (Protection) Act (WPA) తరచుగా కలిసి కనిపిస్తాయి; కానీ ఇవి అడిగే questions వేర్వేరు. IUCN ఒక speciesకు global extinction risk ఎంత ఉందో assess చేస్తుంది. CITES listed speciesలో international tradeను regulate చేస్తుంది. WPA మాత్రం Indiaలో legal protection ఇస్తుంది. అందువల్ల ఒకే speciesకు IUCN category, CITES Appendix, WPA Schedule మూడు ఉండవచ్చు; ఒకదాని labelను మరొకదానికి బదులుగా వాడకూడదు.

paragraphs.en: For assessed taxa, the familiar risk sequence is LC → NT → VU → EN → CR, followed by EW and EX. CR is the highest-risk category for a taxon that still survives in the wild. EW means that it remains only in captivity or cultivation, or as a naturalised population outside its former native range. EX is assigned only when there is no reasonable doubt that the last individual has died.
paragraphs.te: Assess చేసిన taxaలో risk క్రమం LC → NT → VU → EN → CR; తరువాత EW, EX వస్తాయి. Wildలో ఇంకా జీవిస్తున్న taxonకు అత్యధిక extinction riskను Critically Endangered (CR) సూచిస్తుంది. Extinct in the Wild (EW) అంటే captivity లేదా cultivationలో మాత్రమే, లేదా original native range బయట naturalised populationగా మాత్రమే మిగిలి ఉండటం. చివరి individual కూడా చనిపోయిందనే విషయంలో reasonable doubt లేనప్పుడే Extinct (EX)గా classify చేస్తారు.

paragraphs.en: Only VU, EN and CR together form the IUCN 'threatened' categories. Data Deficient is not a reassuring category: it says that the evidence is insufficient to assess extinction risk. Not Evaluated means that the taxon has not yet passed through an IUCN assessment. Thus DD means 'not enough data', whereas NE means 'not yet assessed'.
paragraphs.te: IUCNలో Vulnerable (VU), Endangered (EN), Critically Endangered (CR)ను మాత్రమే కలిపి threatened categories అంటారు. Data Deficient (DD) అంటే risk తక్కువ అని కాదు; extinction riskను assess చేయడానికి evidence సరిపోలేదని అర్థం. Not Evaluated (NE) అంటే ఆ taxonకు ఇంకా IUCN assessment జరగలేదు. సులభంగా గుర్తుంచుకోవాలంటే—DDలో data సరిపోదు; NEలో assessment ఇంకా జరగలేదు.

paragraphs.en: IUCN applies five criterion sets rather than one universal test. A measures population reduction; B examines geographic range; C concerns a small and declining population; D identifies a very small or restricted population; and E uses a quantitative extinction-probability analysis. Meeting any one applicable criterion can justify a category. Under Criterion A, CR–EN–VU thresholds are 90–70–50% for A1 and 80–50–30% for A2–A4, measured across ten years or three generations, whichever is longer. Criterion D can identify danger from extreme smallness even without a demonstrated current decline.
paragraphs.te: IUCN riskను ఒకే formulaతో నిర్ణయించదు; A నుంచి E వరకు five criterion setsను ఉపయోగిస్తుంది. Criterion A population reductionను, B geographic rangeను, C small and declining populationను, D very small లేదా restricted populationను, E quantitative extinction probabilityను పరిశీలిస్తాయి. వర్తించే criteriaలో ఒక్కటి satisfy అయినా category నిర్ణయించవచ్చు. Criterion Aలో CR–EN–VU thresholds A1కు 90–70–50%; A2–A4కు 80–50–30%. Assessment period పది years లేదా మూడు generations—ఏది ఎక్కువైతే అది. Current decline కనిపించకపోయినా population అత్యంత చిన్నదైతే Criterion D riskను గుర్తించగలదు.

paragraphs.en: Project, Recovery Programme and Action Plan describe different administrative instruments. A Project is generally a named and funded implementation mechanism. Under Integrated Development of Wildlife Habitats, the species-recovery component acts as an umbrella that supports several species-specific efforts. An Action Plan is ordinarily a time-bound strategy setting objectives and measures. A State initiative remains a State initiative, and an international partnership does not become an Indian field scheme or statutory authority merely because India participates in it.
paragraphs.te: Project, Recovery Programme, Action Plan ఒకే అర్థం ఇచ్చే terms కావు. సాధారణంగా specific name, funding, implementation mechanism ఉన్నదాన్ని Project అంటారు. Integrated Development of Wildlife Habitats (IDWH) కింద species-recovery component అనేక species-specific effortsకు umbrella programmeగా పనిచేస్తుంది. Action Plan అనేది నిర్ణీత కాలానికి objectives, measures చెప్పే strategy document. State government ప్రారంభించిన initiativeను Central projectగా, India పాల్గొనే international partnershipను Indian field scheme లేదా statutory authorityగా భావించకూడదు.

paragraphs.en: India launched Project Tiger in 1973 to conserve both tigers and their habitats. Tiger-reserve conservation is now overseen by the National Tiger Conservation Authority, which has statutory status. Because new reserves may be notified and existing boundaries may change, a national total has value only when it is attached to the date of the relevant NTCA list.
paragraphs.te: Tigersతో పాటు వాటి habitatsను conserve చేయడానికి India 1973లో Project Tigerను ప్రారంభించింది. ఇప్పుడు Tiger Reserves conservationను statutory body అయిన National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA) oversee చేస్తుంది. కొత్త reserves notify కావచ్చు; existing boundaries మారవచ్చు. కాబట్టి “మొత్తం Tiger Reserves ఎన్ని?” అనే సంఖ్యను relevant NTCA list dateతో కలిపి మాత్రమే చదవాలి.

paragraphs.en: The fifth All India Tiger Estimation was completed in 2022. Government communication commonly cites about 3,682 tigers, while an NTCA FAQ gives 3,652 with a range of 3,167–3,925; each figure must remain tied to its source. The sixth cycle began in 2026, but an interim or reserve-level result cannot stand in for its final national estimate. AITE combines field signs and habitat surveys with camera traps and genetic evidence. M-STrIPES serves a different operational purpose: spatial monitoring and patrol management.
paragraphs.te: Fifth All India Tiger Estimation (AITE) 2022లో పూర్తైంది. Government communicationలో సుమారు 3,682 అనే figure ఎక్కువగా కనిపిస్తుంది; NTCA FAQలో estimate 3,652గా, range 3,167–3,925గా ఉంది. ఈ రెండు figuresను కలపకుండా, respective sourceతోనే quote చేయాలి. Sixth AITE cycle 2026లో మొదలైంది; interim లేదా reserve-level resultను final national estimateగా చెప్పకూడదు. AITEలో field signs, habitat surveys, camera traps, genetic evidenceను combine చేస్తారు. M-STrIPES పని వేరు—spatial monitoring, patrol managementకు support ఇవ్వడం.

paragraphs.en: Calling the tiger an apex predator, keystone species, umbrella species and flagship species does not repeat the same idea four times. Its place at the top of the food web explains the apex-predator role; its strong ecological influence supports the keystone label. Conserving its extensive connected habitat protects many accompanying species, making it an umbrella species. Its public and cultural appeal allows it to mobilise support as a flagship species.
paragraphs.te: Tigerను apex predator, keystone species, umbrella species, flagship species అని పిలిచినా నాలుగు terms ఒకే విషయం చెప్పవు. Food webలో top predatorగా ఉండటం apex role. Ecosystemపై proportionately strong influence చూపడం keystone role. Tigerకు అవసరమైన large, connected habitatను protect చేస్తే అక్కడి అనేక speciesకూ protection లభిస్తుంది—అందుకే umbrella species. Public appeal, cultural value ద్వారా conservation supportను mobilise చేయగలదు—అందుకే flagship species.

paragraphs.en: A tiger leaving a reserve does not automatically prove that the reserve has crossed its carrying capacity. Dispersal may reflect territorial displacement, local density, prey or habitat beyond the reserve, and the condition of corridors. Successful recovery must therefore protect connected landscapes and movement routes, not merely raise the number inside reserve boundaries, while also reducing conflict with people.
paragraphs.te: ఒక tiger reserve బయటకు వెళ్లిందంటే reserve carrying capacity తప్పకుండా exceed అయిందని చెప్పలేం. Territorial displacement, local population density, reserve బయట prey–habitat availability, wildlife corridors condition—all ఇవి dispersalను ప్రభావితం చేస్తాయి. అందువల్ల tiger recoveryను reserve లోపలి headcountతో మాత్రమే కొలవకూడదు; connected landscapes, movement routesను protect చేస్తూ human conflictను కూడా తగ్గించాలి.

paragraphs.en: Project Elephant began in 1992 as a Central conservation project. It seeks to conserve wild Asian elephants, secure habitats and movement corridors, manage human–elephant conflict and improve the welfare of captive elephants. Counting elephants is therefore only one input to a programme whose real scope includes habitat, connectivity, conflict and welfare.
paragraphs.te: Project Elephantను Central conservation projectగా 1992లో ప్రారంభించారు. Wild Asian elephantsను conserve చేయడం, habitats–movement corridorsను secure చేయడం, human–elephant conflictను manage చేయడం, captive elephants welfareను improve చేయడం దీని objectives. కాబట్టి ఇది elephant counting exercise మాత్రమే కాదు; habitat, connectivity, conflict, welfare అన్నింటినీ కలిపిన programme.

paragraphs.en: The 2021–25 Synchronous All India Elephant Estimation reported about 22,446 wild elephants, with an estimated range of 18,255–26,645. It was the first nationally synchronised exercise to identify individuals genetically from dung samples. That method is not directly continuous with older direct-count estimates. Because 27,312 and 29,964 are both cited as 2017 baselines, different comparisons yield different headline percentages. A responsible comparison must name the baseline and explain the methodological break; reserve, corridor and global-share figures must likewise carry dates.
paragraphs.te: 2021–25 Synchronous All India Elephant Estimation (SAIEE) ప్రకారం wild elephants estimate సుమారు 22,446; estimated range 18,255–26,645. Dung samples నుంచి DNAతో individual elephantsను identify చేసిన first nationally synchronised assessment ఇది. Older direct countsతో ఈ methodకు direct continuity లేదు. 2017 baselineగా 27,312, 29,964 అనే రెండు totals కనిపిస్తాయి; ఏ baseline తీసుకుంటే ఆ percentage వస్తుంది. అందుకే decline percentage చెప్పేటప్పుడు comparatorను name చేసి, method changeను explain చేయాలి. Elephant Reserves, corridors, India global share వంటి figuresకూ date అవసరం.

paragraphs.en: Habitat fragmentation often forces elephants following traditional routes to cross farms and settlements, increasing human–elephant conflict. Protecting functional corridors is therefore not an optional addition but a central part of elephant conservation. Gaj Yatra, associated with Project Elephant, is a public-awareness campaign intended to build support for safeguarding those corridors.
paragraphs.te: Habitat fragmentation వల్ల elephants తమ traditional movement routesలో farms, settlementsను cross చేయాల్సి వస్తుంది; ఇక్కడే human–elephant conflict పెరుగుతుంది. అందువల్ల functional elephant corridorsను protect చేయడం supplementary activity కాదు—conservationలో central requirement. Project Elephantతో associated అయిన Gaj Yatra ఒక public-awareness campaign; corridors protectionకు public support పెంచడం దీని purpose.

title.en: From population monitoring to species recovery
title.te: Population monitoring నుంచి species recovery వరకు

paragraphs.en: Wildlife monitoring is not simply a headcount. A census attempts a direct count where that is practicable; an estimate uses sampled evidence to infer the population. In AITE, WII and NTCA integrate field signs, camera-trap records, spatial models and habitat information. A wildlife number becomes meaningful only when its survey year and method are stated with it.
paragraphs.te: Wildlife monitoring అంటే headcount మాత్రమే కాదు. ప్రతి individualను directగా count చేయడం feasible అయినప్పుడు census చేస్తారు; sample evidence నుంచి total populationను infer చేస్తే అది estimate. AITEలో Wildlife Institute of India (WII), NTCA కలిసి field signs, camera-trap records, spatial models, habitat informationను integrate చేస్తాయి. కాబట్టి wildlife figureను survey year, method లేకుండా చదవడం సరైంది కాదు.

paragraphs.en: Gujarat's sixteenth Asiatic-lion estimation recorded 891 lions in 2025, compared with 674 in 2020, and many were outside protected-area boundaries. Growth has not removed the systemic risk: the world's only wild Asiatic-lion population remains concentrated in the Greater Gir landscape. Project Lion was announced on 15 August 2020 and received approval for a ten-year financial outlay on 1 March 2025. It is distinct from the Supreme Court's 2013 Kuno translocation direction, habitat expansion into Barda, and Andhra Pradesh's unrelated Project H.A.N.U.M.A.N.
paragraphs.te: Gujarat 16th Asiatic Lion Estimationలో 2025కు 891 lions నమోదయ్యాయి; 2020లో 674. వీటిలో చాలావరకు protected-area boundaries బయట ఉన్నాయి. Population పెరిగినా systemic risk తొలగలేదు, ఎందుకంటే ప్రపంచంలోని only wild Asiatic-lion population Greater Gir landscapeలోనే concentratedగా ఉంది. Project Lionను 15 August 2020న announce చేశారు; ten-year financial outlayకు 1 March 2025న approval వచ్చింది. ఇది Supreme Court 2013 Kuno translocation direction, Barda habitat expansion, Andhra Pradesh Project H.A.N.U.M.A.N. నుంచి పూర్తిగా వేరు. H.A.N.U.M.A.N. 3 March 2026న ప్రారంభమైన wildlife protection–human conflict State programme; lion project కాదు.

paragraphs.en: India declared the cheetah extinct within the country in 1952, so bringing African cheetahs is a reintroduction, not reinforcement of an existing wild population. Animals have come from Namibia, South Africa and Botswana. Using Kuno and Gandhi Sagar reduces single-site dependence and connects cheetah recovery with grassland conservation. Totals change quickly through births, deaths and transfers: official reporting moved from 57 on 10 May 2026 to about 53 on 13 May after four cub deaths. Every total therefore needs a date and, when relevant, a site-wise break-up.
paragraphs.te: Indiaలో cheetah extinct అయిందని 1952లో declare చేశారు. Existing wild population లేకపోవడంతో African cheetahsను తీసుకురావడం reintroduction; reinforcement కాదు. Animals Namibia, South Africa, Botswana నుంచి వచ్చాయి. Kunoతో పాటు Gandhi Sagarను use చేయడం single-site dependenceను తగ్గించి cheetah recoveryను grassland conservationతో link చేస్తుంది. Births, deaths, transfers వల్ల total వేగంగా మారుతుంది: official reportingలో 10 May 2026న 57 ఉండగా, four cub deaths తరువాత 13 Mayకు సుమారు 53 అయింది. అందుకే ప్రతి totalకు date, అవసరమైతే site-wise distribution ఇవ్వాలి.

paragraphs.en: The Snow Leopard Population Assessment in India, released on 30 January 2024 from 2019–23 fieldwork, estimated 718 snow leopards; Ladakh contributed the largest count, 477. Camera-trap grids and genetic analysis of scat suit a secretive, wide-ranging high-altitude cat. Project Snow Leopard is India's programme, whereas GSLEP is a separate partnership of twelve range countries. Retaliatory killing after livestock loss, poaching, loss of wild prey and competition with livestock remain major threats.
paragraphs.te: 2019–23 fieldwork ఆధారంగా రూపొందిన Snow Leopard Population Assessment in India (SPAI)ను 30 January 2024న release చేశారు. India estimate 718; highest share Ladakhలో 477. Elusiveగా ఉండి wide high-altitude rangeలో తిరిగే ఈ catకు camera-trap grids, scat genetic analysis suitable methods. Project Snow Leopard Indian programme; Global Snow Leopard and Ecosystem Protection Program (GSLEP) మాత్రం twelve-country partnership. Livestock loss తరువాత retaliatory killing, poaching, wild prey depletion, livestock competition ప్రధాన threats.

paragraphs.en: Project Dolphin covers dolphins of rivers, estuaries and the sea, but the figure of about 6,327 has a narrower meaning. It comes from India's first comprehensive river-dolphin assessment, reported in 2025 for the Ganga, Brahmaputra and Indus systems; it is not a total for every dolphin covered by the project. A second range-wide assessment of riverine and estuarine dolphins began in January 2026 to create a comparable time series. Survey and year must accompany every figure.
paragraphs.te: Project Dolphin scopeలో river, estuary, marine dolphins ఉన్నాయి. కానీ సుమారు 6,327 అనే figureకు narrower meaning ఉంది: ఇది 2025లో report చేసిన first comprehensive river-dolphin assessmentలో Ganga, Brahmaputra, Indus systemsకు సంబంధించిన total మాత్రమే. Projectలోని అన్ని freshwater, estuarine, marine dolphins total కాదు. Comparable time series నిర్మించడానికి second range-wide riverine–estuarine assessment January 2026లో ప్రారంభమైంది. ప్రతి figureతో survey, year తప్పనిసరిగా చెప్పాలి.

paragraphs.en: The gharial is a Critically Endangered, predominantly fish-eating crocodilian. Much of the surviving population is concentrated in the Chambal, and the species needs free-flowing rivers with suitable sandbanks. Dams and sand mining also damage river-dolphin habitat. Releasing head-started gharials into Chambal's existing population is reinforcement; releasing them where they had disappeared locally, such as the Beas or the Ganga at Murshidabad, is reintroduction.
paragraphs.te: Gharial ప్రధానంగా fish-eating crocodilian; IUCN status Critically Endangered. Surviving populationలో పెద్ద భాగం Chambalలో concentratedగా ఉంది. దీనికి free-flowing rivers, suitable sandbanks అవసరం. Dams, sand mining వల్ల river dolphins habitatకూ damage జరుగుతుంది. Head-started gharialsను existing Chambal populationలో release చేస్తే reinforcement. Species locally disappeared అయిన Beas లేదా Murshidabad వద్ద Gangaలో release చేస్తే reintroduction.

paragraphs.en: Project Crocodile began in 1975 through cooperation among the Government of India, UNDP and FAO. It covered the gharial, mugger and saltwater crocodile, globally classified as CR, VU and LC respectively. Eggs were collected and incubated; young crocodilians were reared through their most vulnerable stage and then released, with support also going to breeding centres and protected areas. More than 7,000 releases had been reported by the fiftieth anniversary in 2025. Recovery was uneven: mugger and saltwater crocodile populations improved markedly, while the gharial remained CR.
paragraphs.te: Project Crocodileను 1975లో Government of India, UNDP, FAO cooperationతో ప్రారంభించారు. ఇందులో gharial, mugger, saltwater crocodile ఉన్నాయి; వాటి global IUCN categories వరుసగా CR, VU, LC. Eggs collect చేసి incubate చేయడం, young crocodiliansను vulnerable early stage దాటే వరకు rear చేసి suitable habitatలో release చేయడం programme method. Breeding centres, protected areasకూ support ఇచ్చారు. 2025లో 50th anniversary నాటికి 7,000కుపైగా releases report అయ్యాయి. Recovery equalగా లేదు: mugger, saltwater crocodile populations బాగా improve కాగా gharial ఇంకా CRలోనే ఉంది.

paragraphs.en: White-rumped, long-billed and slender-billed vultures fell by more than 95%, chiefly after feeding on livestock carcasses contaminated with veterinary diclofenac; habitat loss was not the principal driver of this crash. India banned veterinary diclofenac in 2006. The National Vulture Action Plan covered 2020–25 and cannot automatically be called current after that period. A captive-bred release is reinforcement where a wild colony remains and reintroduction where the species has vanished locally. Because vultures remove carcasses, their decline can favour feral dogs and raise disease and rabies risks.
paragraphs.te: White-rumped, long-billed, slender-billed vultures 95%కుపైగా decline కావడానికి main cause habitat loss కాదు. Veterinary diclofenac ఉన్న livestock carcasses తినడం వల్ల toxic effect వచ్చింది. India veterinary diclofenac useను 2006లో ban చేసింది. National Vulture Action Plan period 2020–25; successor verify చేయకుండా 2026లో current plan అని చెప్పకూడదు. Wild colony ఇంకా ఉన్న చోట captive-bred birds release చేస్తే reinforcement; locally vanished చోట release చేస్తే reintroduction. Vultures carcasses తొలగిస్తాయి; అవి తగ్గితే feral dogs పెరిగి disease, rabies risk పెరగవచ్చు.

paragraphs.en: The Great Indian Bustard is Critically Endangered and now survives chiefly in the Thar. Collision with overhead high-tension power lines is a major documented recent mortality pressure, creating a difficult overlap between renewable-energy infrastructure and bustard habitat. Releasing captive-bred birds into the surviving Thar population would be reinforcement; restoring the species to Madhya Pradesh after local extinction would be reintroduction. The reported captive total of 94 birds, including 26 chicks, belongs specifically to June 2026.
paragraphs.te: Great Indian Bustard (GIB) Critically Endangered; ఇప్పుడు ప్రధానంగా Tharలో survives. Overhead high-tension power linesతో collision recent deathsకు major documented cause. అందువల్ల renewable-energy infrastructure, GIB habitat overlapను carefulగా manage చేయాలి. Captive-bred birdsను surviving Thar populationలో release చేస్తే reinforcement; locally extinct అయిన Madhya Pradeshకు restore చేస్తే reintroduction. Captive centresలో 94 birds, వాటిలో 26 chicks అనే total June 2026 reportకు మాత్రమే సంబంధించినది.

paragraphs.en: The destination population—not the publicity label of a programme—determines the release term. Reintroduction restores a species to an area from which it has disappeared; reinforcement adds individuals to a population that still survives. Conservation translocation is the broader idea of deliberate human-assisted movement and can serve either purpose. India's cheetah release is clearly reintroduction, while gharial, vulture and Great Indian Bustard releases must be classified site by site.
paragraphs.te: Release termను programme publicity name నిర్ణయించదు; destinationలో species status నిర్ణయిస్తుంది. Species disappeared అయిన areaకు తిరిగి తీసుకెళితే reintroduction. Existing populationకు individuals add చేస్తే reinforcement. Conservation translocation అనేది deliberate human-assisted movement అనే broader term; అది ఈ రెండు purposesలో దేనికైనా ఉపయోగపడవచ్చు. India cheetah release స్పష్టంగా reintroduction. Gharial, vulture, Great Indian Bustard releasesను మాత్రం chosen site status బట్టి classify చేయాలి.
